description: Checks a GPU cluster against XportL's published support matrix (Linux 5.8+ for eBPF, InfiniBand / RoCE v2 / NVLink, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, NCCL / RCCL, on-prem / cloud / hybrid, host access for the eBPF agent). Returns a verdict (good fit / needs review / not ready), each check, and next steps. Anything not on the published list is reported as 'review', never as supported.

collective_library.description: Collective communication libraries in use. Default ['nccl'].

fabrics.description: Every interconnect the GPU jobs use, e.g. ['infiniband','nvlink']. efa = AWS Elastic Fabric Adapter.

host_access.description: Can you run a privileged agent on the GPU hosts? eBPF needs root or CAP_BPF/CAP_PERFMON. 'none' = fully managed service with no host access.

host_os.description: Host operating system on the GPU nodes.

linux_kernel.description: Host kernel version as printed by `uname -r`, e.g. '5.15.0-105-generic'. Leave empty for non-Linux hosts or if unknown.

name: check_cluster_compatibility
title: Cluster Compatibility Check
